set.body:
Confirmed baseline failure: StructuralFirstLevelScenarioSuite S07 gives simple effect 0.4705485415038636 vs planted 0.6 and main effect 0.9767596222399185 vs 1.3. The same observations occur with all four ownership-repair production files replaced by HEAD. This is not a matrix-ownership regression.
Files: modules/fit/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/fmri/fit/scenarios/StructuralFirstLevelScenarioSuite.scala (runTwoByTwoScenario and synthesize); new portable oracle fixture/generator only as needed; docs/scenarios/manifest.json if evidence metadata changes.
Read docs/audits/spmg-correction.md first. Retain the corrected canonical and dispersion basis. synthesize currently adds fixed 0.03 sine/cosine noise then asserts absolute raw-beta errors < 0.1; that recovery bound is not invariant to basis scale/conditioning.
Steps: expose the planted beta/noise construction; test exact noiseless semantic contrasts separately with a numerical tolerance justified by rank/conditioning. For the existing noisy data, compute expected contrast estimates using an independent QR reference for the exact realized X/Y and assert agreement with that reference. Keep the realistic noisy case visible; do not delete it, reduce its noise just to pass, increase the old 0.1 threshold, or assume the finite-sample estimate equals its population beta. Record raw-coordinate versus response-functional meaning.
Acceptance: S07 and every other StructuralFirstLevelScenarioSuite case pass on JVM and JS; independent expected values cannot be generated by ScalaFIM's own fitter. Required commands: sbt 'fitJVM/testOnly scalafim.fmri.fit.scenarios.StructuralFirstLevelScenarioSuite' and the fitJS equivalent; manifest/receipt checks when fixtures change. Link this result in the acceptance ledger.
set.title: P4.4k: repair the S07 planted-effect oracle after the corrected SPMG basis
